chunks: Yūnus narrated from Zurārah, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

ʿAlī عليه السلام said: “Indeed, when a man drinks wine, he becomes intoxicated; when he becomes intoxicated, he raves; and when he raves, he fabricates. So flog him with the punishment of the fabricator.”

key_terms.حَدَّ الْمُفْتَرِي: the prescribed punishment of the false accuser/fabricator

ai.seo_question: Why does the hadith assign the punishment of a fabricator to the one who drinks wine?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a legal rationale linking the drinking of wine to intoxication, incoherent speech, and false accusation. It indicates that intoxication leads to slanderous fabrication, and therefore prescribes the hadd punishment associated with false accusation.
